crossRefs.note: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

translations.web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
translations.bsb: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
translations.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
translations.asv: upon which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw the fourfooted beasts of the earth and wild beasts and creeping things and birds of the heaven.
